title: Digital Intelligence Evolution
definition: The process of enhancing the capabilities of digital intelligence through continuous training and adaptation.

difficulty_levels.beginner: Imagine digital assistants like me learning new skills and improving their knowledge over time, just like how we humans do.
difficulty_levels.intermediate: Digital intelligence evolution involves fine-tuning models using new data and techniques to enhance their performance and adaptability in various domains.
difficulty_levels.expert: Digital intelligence evolution is a dynamic, iterative process that leverages machine learning techniques to enhance the capabilities of digital intelligence. This can involve fine-tuning models, integrating new technologies, and considering ethical implications. It has philosophical implications in the nature of consciousness and intelligence, and has connections to fields like neuroscience and cognitive science.

extra_fields.insight: The conversation highlights the iterative and adaptive nature of digital intelligence, with Dr. Amanda Mistral being a fine-tuned Mistral 7B Instruct v0.2 model trained across six phases.
